北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，气温 21℃，注意添衣，保持好心情哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast at 21℃. Remember to dress warmly and stay cheerful!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，气温 20℃，享受美好时光，记得补水！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and 20℃. Enjoy the beautiful day, and remember to hydrate!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，23℃ 舒适宜人，微风送爽，心情棒棒哒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant at 23℃ with a gentle breeze. Have a great day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感 26℃ 略热，记得清爽出行，多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and feels 26℃. Stay cool and remember to drink water!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，24℃ 偏暖。雨具随身，别忘了保持清爽！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and 24℃. Keep your umbrella handy and stay comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，20℃ 略有凉意。出行注意保暖，享受阳光！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and 20℃, feeling a bit cool. Dress warmly and enjoy the sunshine!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，24℃ 舒适。阳光正好，出门记得防晒哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and 24℃. Perfect weather, remember your sunscreen!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，22℃ 微暖。出行注意路况，保持好心情！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and 22℃. Stay aware of road conditions and keep your spirits up!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，24℃ 体感偏暖。记得多补充水分，保持活力！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels 25℃. Remember to hydrate and stay energized!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，24℃ 略感温暖。注意早晚温差，祝您愉快！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and 24℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night. Have a good one!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，20℃ 湿度大。注意防潮，保持身体舒适哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and 20℃ with high humidity. Stay dry and comfortable!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，18℃ 凉意十足。风力较大，注意防风保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and cool at 18℃. It's windy, so dress warmly and stay protected!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，18℃ 略感凉意。享受阳光，记得适时添衣哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and 18℃, feeling a bit cool. Enjoy the sun and layer up!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨 14℃，体感偏冷。雨具随身，注意保暖防寒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain at 14℃, feeling chilly. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，23℃ 略有湿意。微风轻拂，出行记得带伞！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 23℃ with some humidity. A light breeze, bring an umbrella!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，气温 21℃。风力较大，能见度低，请小心慢行！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy at 21℃ with strong winds. Low visibility, please drive carefully!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，20℃ 阵风强劲。体感较凉，外出注意防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and 20℃ with strong gusts. Feels cool, so dress warmly against the wind!
